title: Fix the Last Character Printer
description: The program should print the last character of a string. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 'n', the last character of 'Python'.
actualProblem: Valid indices for a string of length 6 run from 0 to 5; len(text) is 6, which is one past the last valid index, so this raises an IndexError.
explanation: String indexing is zero-based, so the last character sits at index len(text) - 1, not len(text). Alternatively, text[-1] accesses the last character directly.
